items.t: Severe frame rust
items.job: Replace frame and transfer body, suspension and lines
items.note: Toyota's old frame programs have mostly ended, but ask a dealer with your VIN. A used frame costs less.

items.t: Rear crossmember rust can drop the spare tire (recall)
items.job: Replace rear frame crossmember and nearby brake lines
items.note: Recall covers 2000-2003 trucks in salt-belt states. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Front ball joint wear and separation
items.job: Replace front lower ball joints (both sides) and align
items.note: Recalls covered many 2002-2006 trucks. Check your VIN. Upper joints add cost if also worn.

items.t: Secondary air pump failure
items.job: Replace secondary air pump and check valve
items.note: Sometimes only a valve is needed, which costs less.

items.t: Secondary air injection pump or valve failure
items.job: Replace secondary air pump and air switching valve
items.note: Toyota's extended coverage has likely ended, but ask a dealer with your VIN. Cost rises if both pumps fail.

items.t: Frame rust (frame replacement program)
items.job: Replace frame and transfer body, suspension and lines
items.note: The frame programs have mostly ended, but ask a Toyota dealer with your VIN. A used frame costs less.

items.t: Leaking water pump
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant

items.t: Cam tower oil leak
items.job: Reseal camshaft housings (cam towers)
items.note: Labor-heavy job. Ask the shop about doing other seals or the water pump at the same time.

items.t: Cracked exhaust manifold or leaking gasket
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold, gasket and studs
items.note: Price is per side. Broken studs add a lot of labor time.

items.t: Rear driveshaft clunk
items.job: Lubricate driveshaft slip yoke and replace worn U-joints
items.note: If the bulletin calls for a new driveshaft, expect much more.

items.t: Rear axle bearing howl
items.job: Replace rear axle bearings and seals (both sides)
items.note: Cost rises if the axle shaft is damaged by a failed bearing.

items.t: Front brake vibration
items.job: Replace front brake rotors and pads

items.t: Charcoal canister contamination
items.job: Replace EVAP charcoal canister

items.t: Twin-turbo V6 main bearing failure (recalls)
items.job: Replace engine assembly
items.note: Covered by several recalls on 2022-2024 trucks. Check your VIN and see a dealer before driving.

items.t: Rear axle shaft nuts can loosen (recall 22V-445)
items.job: Tighten or replace rear axle flange nuts
items.note: Free under recall 22V-445. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel tube can rub on a brake line and leak (recall 23V-566)
items.job: Replace fuel tube and add clamp
items.note: Free under recall 23V-566. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Truck can creep forward in Neutral (recall 24V-125)
items.job: Update transmission software
items.note: Free under recall 24V-125. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Instrument panel screen can go blank (recall 23V-111)
items.job: Update instrument cluster software
items.note: Free under recall 23V-111. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rearview camera image may not display (recalls)
items.job: Update parking assist software
items.note: Free under recall 25V-657 / 22V-285 / 22V-501. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Reverse lights can fail from moisture (recall 25V-322)
items.job: Replace reverse light assemblies
items.note: Free under recall 25V-322. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Electric parking brake may not engage (recall 22V-661)
items.job: Update brake control software
items.note: Free under recall 22V-661. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power steering gear can leak
items.job: Replace hydraulic power steering gear
items.note: Free under recall 21V-920 or 21E-103. Check the VIN first.

items.t: High and low beams can power together and overheat the wiring
items.job: Modify headlight harness and replace damaged parts
items.note: Free under recall 21V-688. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Low-pressure fuel pump can fail and stall the engine
items.job: Replace low pressure fuel pump
items.note: Free under recall 20V-682. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front turn signals may not flash brightly enough
items.job: Modify front turn signal wiring harness
items.note: Free under recall 20V-410. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Accessory dual exhaust can rub a brake line
items.job: Replace accessory exhaust and brake line
items.note: Free under recall 05V-123. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Load capacity label may show the wrong weight
items.job: Install corrected load capacity label
items.note: Free under recalls 26V-179, 26V-433 and 26V-571. Check the VIN first.
